panel.name: wf_panel
panel.text: These are the same overlays as Develop > Render Metadata, and toggling either place moves both. The drainage and air views are distance-thinned; the field overlay also reads SSAtmoWindFlowDebugRange.

check_box.name: info_overlay_check
check_box.label: Show info overlay
check_box.tool_tip: On-screen readout of weather values, including the world field's capture health and what its air flood says about the camera's own cell

check_box.name: field_overlay_check
check_box.label: Draw the world field
check_box.tool_tip: The view picked below. Same overlay as Develop > Render Metadata > World field

combo_box.name: C_field_view
combo_box.tool_tip: Band surfaces: every surface the capture resolved, hue by band so stacked storeys read separately. Air labels: the connectivity flood, outside-connected air green and fading with occlusion depth, sealed interior air red. Drainage: standing water blue and the D8 outlet chain of the filled surface. True ground: the wind profile's ground reference per column - topmost real ground, tall structures filled from their neighbours

panel.text: One region-anchored capture of the world's solid structure, shared by the surface, coverage, air and drainage channels. The dials below tune the capture; a change drops the cached tiles and they rebuild under the new setting.

check_box.name: field_enabled_check
check_box.label: Capture the world field
check_box.tool_tip: Off stops all capture; builds nothing until one of the channels that read the field is demanded

check_box.name: field_surfacetop_check
check_box.label: Serve the surface field from the field
check_box.tool_tip: The wet/snow/puddle field and runoff read their landing grid from the world field's SURFACE_TOP channel instead of the rain shadow capture. On when you want the field's columns behind the surface sim

check_box.name: field_coverage_check
check_box.label: Serve the soundscape from the field
check_box.tool_tip: The audio mix reads its roof cover, burial and sealed-room verdict from the field's COVERAGE channel instead of the live raycasts. On is what makes tiles build here for audio

text.name: T_field_cell
text.tool_tip: Metres per column. 2m is a 128x128 column grid over a 256m region; finer resolves narrower walls and costs more capture and more flood work
